name: Qinghai Lake
hours: 8:00–18:00 (seasonal)
hl: China's largest saltwater lake — 4,300 km² of deep blue under the Qinghai plateau sky
June–August: a golden sea of rapeseed flowers around the shores
Cycle a section of the lakeside highway, or ride horses on the grass flats
how: High-speed rail to Xining (from Lanzhou 1.5h), then 2h bus to the lake; or join a loop tour.
tips: Altitude ~3,200 m — hydrate and go slow on the first day
Early morning is calmest for mirror-like reflections
hotel: Erlangjian lakeside hotels — 3★, from ¥260/night.

name: Chaka Salt Lake
hours: 6:00–21:00 (seasonal)
hl: 'The Mirror of the Sky' — a white salt flat that reflects clouds perfectly when calm
Wear waterproof boots or rent overshoes and wade out for the classic reflection shot
The train ride across the salt lake is the easy way to the best spots
how: From Xining, 4h drive or join the Qinghai Lake–Chaka loop tour (2 days).
tips: Sunset (19:00–20:00) gives the reddest reflections; wind ruins the mirror — check forecasts
White or red clothing photographs best against the salt

name: Kumbum Monastery (Ta'er)
hours: Usually 08:00–17:00 (holy sites 07:30–18:00)
hl: The birthplace of the Dalai Lamas' sect — butter sculptures, applique and murals
Kumbum Monastery (Ta'er) holds living rituals — watch monks and pilgrims, not just the architecture.
The climb/entrance path is part of the experience: incense smoke, prayer flags and bells set the tone.
how: Temples in Xining are a short taxi/metro ride from center; mountain temples need a bus + cableway.
tips: Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered) and remove hats in main halls.
Morning incense hours (07:00–09:00) are atmospheric; photography is usually fine outdoors only.
hotel: Stay in Xining (mid-range ¥300–600; luxury from ¥800) — see the hotel map layer.

Side courtyards, pagoda or scripture hall — the quiet part

name: Menyuan Rapeseed Sea
hours: Open fields all day; viewing decks 07:00–19:00
hl: A 500,000-mu golden sea beneath the Qilian snows — July's most Tibetan-colored valley
Menyuan Rapeseed Sea is 1,000-year human geometry — hillsides carved into amphitheaters of light.
The mirror-moment at dawn or dusk makes every photo look painted.
how: Rail to Haibei then 1–2 h winding drive to the terrace villages; hire a car or take the village shuttle.
tips: Sunrise over water-filled terraces is the classic shot — stay in the village the night before.
Check which terraces are flooded/mirror season; 'dry' terraces are still beautiful but different.
hotel: Stay in Haibei (mid-range ¥300–600; luxury from ¥800) — see the hotel map layer.

plan.title: Terrace viewpoints loop
plan.tip: Sunrise deck first, village lanes second, highest terrace last.
steps: Village walk — houses, water channels & daily life
Terrace field path — walk into the mosaic

name: Qilian Mountain Grassland
hours: Open all day; seasonal visitor centers 08:30–17:30
hl: Silky green pastures against snow peaks — yaks, horses and the 'eastern Switzerland'
Qilian Mountain Grassland is wide and slow — the point is the horizon, the breeze and the nomad camps.
Golden-hour photography is the payoff: grass turns amber at 18:00–19:30.
how: Fly/rail to Haibei, then 1–2 h drive to the grassland — hire a car or join a day tour (roads are empty).
tips: Altitude is 1,500–3,500 m — take it slow, carry water and sun protection.
Yurt stays need a pre-booking; horse riding is safer with the ranch's own guide.
hotel: Stay in Haibei (mid-range ¥300–600; luxury from ¥800) — see the hotel map layer.

name: Kanbula Forest Park
hours: Parks 08:00–18:00 (sunset decks stay open later)
hl: Red danxia cliffs above a jade reservoir — the Lijiaxia lake and Tibetan monasteries
Kanbula Forest Park is a geological rainbow — red, gold and purple strata folded into cliffs.
Photographers: overcast days are actually best for danxia color saturation.
how: Rail/flight to Huangnan then 40–90 min to the danxia park; shuttle buses link the viewpoints.
tips: Danxia colors pop in soft light — schedule the main viewpoint for sunrise or 16:30+.
The shuttle bus order matters: ask the driver for the sunset viewpoint route.
hotel: Stay in Huangnan (mid-range ¥300–600; luxury from ¥800) — see the hotel map layer.

plan.title: Color-band circuit

hours: Usually 08:00–17:30; cruises run 09:00–16:00
duration: Half day to full day — 3–5 h
hl: Turquoise and teal salt pools in the Gobi — a mirror palette of an abandoned mine
Emerald Lake (Dachaidan) is best read from the water — take the boat or bamboo raft instead of only the shore path.
Late afternoon light turns the lake into a mirror; sunset cruises sell out, book ahead.
how: High-speed rail to Haixi then a 30–60 min bus/taxi to the lake or river pier; ferries/rafts are usually sold with the ticket.
tips: Buy the ticket + boat/raft combo in one go — walk-up boat tickets cost more and queue longer.
Visit on a clear weekday morning for mirror-flat water; afternoons bring tour groups.

name: Zhuoer Mountain
hours: Usually 07:30–17:30 (peak season); cableways may close in rain
duration: Half to full day — allow 4–6 h
hl: Red-and-green ridge lines above Qilian town — the 'Danxia of the Emerald Sea'
Zhuoer Mountain ranks among China's most dramatic mountain landscapes, with cloud seas and granite silhouettes.
Plan a full-day visit: cable car up, ridge walks, and the summit viewpoint before the afternoon haze.
how: Fly or take a high-speed train to Haibei; from the city, a 40–90 min bus/shuttle reaches the scenic area, then cable cars or walking trails take you up.
tips: Start early to beat queues at the cableway and catch clear mountain light.
Altitude rises quickly — carry water, sunscreen and a light jacket even in summer.

hl: 清东陵（滿語：ᡩ᠋ᡝ᠋ᡵᡤᡳ ᡝᡵᡤᡳ ᠮᡠᠩᡤᠠᠨ，羅馬化：dergi ergi munggan）坐落在中华人民共和国河北省遵化市境西北部马兰峪的昌瑞山一带，西距北京市区125公里，距离天津150公里，是清朝三大陵园中最大的一座。整座陵园共有5座帝陵，4座后陵，5座皇妃陵寝，8座皇子陵寝，4座奶妈坟，1座贞官墓和1座穆公墓，其中部分皇子陵寝分布于天津市境内。这些陵寝均建造于清朝年间，整座陵园的最后的2位墓主人下葬于1935年。清东陵在清朝存续期间一直都有专门的机构主持祭祀，也有专门的部队对陵寝及其周边进行护卫。清朝灭亡后，清东陵的保护机构已经无力守卫整

name: Long Lin Gong Yuan
hours: 07:30–18:00 (earlier opening in summer)
hl: 在汉字文化圈中，龙，又称中国龙、東方龍，是中国神话、中国民俗中的传说生物。龙有许多类似动物的形态，有如龟形和鱼形，常被描述的是有四足的蛇形。有学者们对中国龙的起源确定了四种可靠的理论：蛇、中华短吻鳄、闪电和自然崇拜。传统上，龙象征着强大和吉祥的力量，特别是对水、降雨、台风和洪水的控制。许多中国谚语和成语都提到了龙，例如“望子成龙”和“龙马精神”。 龙也流传到汉字文化圈各地的文化传统里，如臺灣、韩国、越南和日本。清朝的“黄龙旗”影响了许多欧洲国家对東方式龙的印象。而在现代，不丹国旗的白龙是一条典型的東方式龙。

hl: 海南藏族自治州（藏語：མཚོ་ལྷོ་བོད་རིགས་རང་སྐྱོང་ཁུལ།，威利转写：mtsho-lho bod-rigs rang-skyong-khul，藏语拼音：Colho Pörig Ranggyong Kü），簡稱海南州，是中华人民共和国青海省下辖的自治州。州境东北抵西宁市、海东市，东邻黄南州，南接果洛州，西连海西州。地处青藏高原东部，北部为青海湖盆地，中部为共和盆地，南部为阿尼玛卿山北麓。昆仑山支脉青海南山、鄂拉山横亘中部。黄河由南往北呈“C”字形流贯全境，纳曲什安河、茫拉河等支流，州境中部建有龙羊峡水库。布哈河、黑马河、倒淌河等河流
Qing Hai Hu Hei Ma He（青海湖·黑马河）is a visitor attraction in Qinghai, Qinghai — set aside half to full day for the main circuit.
Best season: Apr–Oct. Arrive within 30 minutes of opening to stay ahead of tour groups.
how: Gateway: Qinghai, Qinghai. Reach the city by high-speed rail or flight, then local bus, taxi or DiDi to the gate (often 30–90 minutes). Use the Chinese name「青海湖·黑马河」in map/taxi apps — English signs are uneven.
tips: Carry your passport: many ticketed sites in Qinghai require real-name booking for foreign visitors.
Pay with Alipay or WeChat Pay (link an international card before you travel); cash is rarely useful.
Avoid the first three days of Golden Week (early Oct) and the Spring Festival rush if you want quieter paths.
hotel: Base in Qinghai: comfortable 3–4★ hotels typically ¥250–750/night within a taxi ride of the site; book early for weekends and holidays.

name: Long Yang Da Xia Gu Jing Qu
hours: 08:00–17:30 (last entry ~15:30 for longer trails)
hl: 天山大峡谷是位于新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐县境内的自然风景区。是国家级森林公园，也是国家5A级景区。距离乌鲁木齐市区40多公里，景区总面积1038.48平方公里，平均海拔超过2000米，年平均气温4－6℃。天山大峡谷拥有天山北坡最完整的原始雪岭云杉林，也因居住在此的哈萨克牧民部落被称为是“游牧文化的博物馆”。新疆照壁山国家湿地公园也位于景区内。
